## What's on your mind

An idea, a question, a problem you see, or a claim you think doesn't hold.

## Why it matters

What would change if this were done, answered, or fixed?

## Which part of ZLAR it touches (if you know)

For example, one of [ZLAR's Principles](https://github.com/ZLAR-AI/ZLAR/blob/main/PRINCIPLES.md),
a folder, or a specific file. It's fine not to know.
